name: ui/address-code
title: AddressCode
summary: A Kweli address code as a chip: the code in the mono face (a <code>), and a link that opens the address. Without `href` the chip is the code alone.

props.name: href
props.description: Where the code resolves ("https://kweli.mukoko.com/a/NYU-7K2Q"). No link without it.

props.name: label
props.description: What the code is, for assistive technology; also names the link.

props.name: class
props.description: Extra classes on the root, merged last.

behaviour: The code is a <code> in the mono face with wide tracking, so it can be copied by eye or read aloud.
With `href`, a 44px link follows the code; its accessible name is "<linkLabel> <label> <code>", so repeated chips never read as identical links.
Without `href`, there is no link and no empty control.
Colour is semantic: the chip is the card on its border; the link is --primary, so a brand overlay (Kweli's malachite) colours it.

keyboard: Tab to the link; Enter follows it.
focus: The --ring focus ring on the link.
aria: A visually hidden label names what the code is; the link's aria-label names the code it opens.

theming.brandOverlay: Only --primary (the link) and --ring change with the brand; Kweli's overlay makes them malachite.

noJs.without: Everything: the component is server-rendered HTML with no script.

responsive: The code truncates in a narrow container; the link never shrinks.
contract:
contract
  slot is "address-code"
  portal is "https://mzizi.dev/components/address-code"
  class has "rounded-full"
  when default shows code "NYU-7K2Q"
  a "Open" min_height 44
  when labelled shows a "Directions"
end

checks.say: The code is in the mono face.
The link's name names the code.
The label is there for assistive technology.

gaps: No copy-to-clipboard: the component has no script. An app that wants one adds it beside the chip; a copy action belongs in a separate enhancement, not this contract.
